reason: E-20260929-03 is the CTO's priority 2 comparison on our own decisions. It tests whether Winnow-12B, the one open model resolved above hosted Jev on JevBench v1.5, is non-inferior to Jev at linking within 3 points when run zero-shot on one GPU. It produces per-model calibration tables that bear on B14 (working). It is distinct from E-20260928-12-r2 (fine-tuned open model) and E-20260928-08-r2 (implements links on SpecMine). Now is the time because JevBench v1.5 (2026-09-28) is the first third-party board where open 12B models tie or pass Jev. It needs no new labels (it reuses E-20260929-02's and E-20260928-18-r2's) and costs about 6 runs and 25 USD.
